entities.name: Odunos
entities.description: City on the Siren Sea coast of Theros inhabited by hateful Returned who raid the living.

entities.name: Returned
entities.description: Masked undead who escaped the Underworld; those in Odunos are motivated by hate and envy of the living.

entities.name: Tymaret
entities.description: De facto ruler of Odunos, a Returned warlord and servant of Erebos charged with dragging Phenax back to the Underworld.

entities.name: Erebos
entities.description: God of the dead, dominant deity in Odunos; Tymaret serves him.

entities.name: Phenax
entities.description: God of deception who as a mortal escaped the Underworld and conquered Odunos.

entities.name: Athreos
entities.description: God whose notice Phenax avoided when escaping the Underworld.

entities.name: Black Oak of Odunos
entities.description: Large tree guarding Odunos's entrance, said to be made from the bodies of its original inhabitants.

entities.name: Bothros
entities.description: Bottomless pit at the northern edge of Odunos where raiders dispose of spoils and captives.

entities.name: Crypts of the Lost
entities.description: Large cemetery inland, inhabited by lost Returned.

entities.name: Path of Phenax
entities.description: First path out of the Underworld, discovered by Phenax.

entities.name: Underworld
entities.description: Realm of the dead from which the Returned escaped.

events.summary: Phenax becomes the first mortal to escape the Underworld unnoticed by Athreos or Erebos.
events.quote: Phenax was the first mortal to escape the Underworld without drawing the notice of Athreos or Erebos

events.summary: Phenax assembles Returned, conquers Odunos, slaughters the population and binds their souls to the Black Oak.
events.quote: conquered Odunos, slaughtering the population and binding their souls to the Black Oak

events.summary: Tymaret witnesses Phenax's escape and informs Erebos, who lets him leave the Underworld as a Returned to catch Phenax.
events.quote: The only witness to Phenax's escape was Tymaret

events.summary: Tymaret sends nightly raiding parties against minotaurs and human settlements near Akros.
events.quote: Tymaret regularly sends nightly raiding parties

relations.quote: The de facto ruler of Odunos is the tyrant Tymaret

relations.note: charged with dragging Phenax back to the Underworld
relations.quote: Tymaret has been charged with dragging the trickster god Phenax back to the Underworld

relations.note: said to have created the oak
relations.quote: Phenax is said to have created the oak

relations.note: located near the badlands of Phoberos
relations.quote: Odunos is located near the badlands of Phoberos on the coast of the Siren Sea.
